name: Index Texture Cache for Spline Search
definition: An acceleration technique that caches the indices of spline segments used in previous rendering slices to avoid redundant binary searches for the current slice, leveraging depth-order coherence in front-to-back traversal.
summary: Index Texture Cache for Spline Search accelerates volume rendering by caching spline segment indices to replace redundant binary searches with incremental linear searches, leveraging depth-order coherence.
